name: I Never Loved a Man the Way I Love You

info.label: Atlantic
info.desc: I Never Loved a Man the Way I Love You is the tenth studio album by American singer Aretha Franklin. Released on March 10, 1967, by Atlantic Records (her first with that label), it went to number 2 on the Billboard album chart and number 1 on the magazine's Top R&B Selling chart. It was certified Gold by the RIAA in 1967. It received a number 83 ranking on Rolling Stone magazine's 2003 list of the 500 greatest albums of all time and inclusion in both the 1001 Albums You Must Hear Before You Die (2005) and 1,000 Recordings to .

podcast.body: This LP marked Franklin's debut with Atlantic Records and was recorded following her pivotal session at FAME Studios in Muscle Shoals, Alabama, and continued at Atlantic's studios in New York City. The album climbed to number two on the Billboard album chart, where it remained for three weeks, positioned between LPs by The Monkees, The Mamas and the Poppas, and Jefferson Airplane. It spent a year and a half on the chart and became her first million-seller, solidifying her status as an album artist at the peak of 60s rock. "Her LP, I Never Loved a Man the Way I Love You, climbed to number two on the Billboard album chart and stayed there three weeks."
